name: hybrid-ssm-8b
provenance: Representative of an attention/state-space hybrid (Nemotron-H-8B class): 24 Mamba layers, 4 attention, 24 MLP. Dimensions approximate that architecture family, not a verified checkpoint config. Present because a recurrent state is constant per request while KV is linear in context -- the two are equal at about 6,200 tokens here -- and because the fixed state forces the attention block size up, which moves block counts and every block hash value.
